identity.title: Verify your identity
identity.subtitle: We need your national ID and a clear photo of you to confirm who you are. This takes about two minutes.
identity.idNumberHint: The 14-digit number printed on the front of your card

errors.idNumber: Your national ID number must be exactly 14 digits.
errors.missingCaptures: Please capture all three photos before submitting.

identity.documentsSubtitle: Make sure all text is sharp, there is no glare, and the whole card is inside the frame.

selfie.title: Personal photo
selfie.hint: A clear selfie, face fully visible

identity.formats: Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 8 MB per photo
identity.privacyBody: Documents are stored privately and encrypted. Only authorized Maskan reviewers can see them, and only to verify your identity.

identityStatus.title: Identity verification

processing.title: Checking your documents
processing.body: We're automatically reading your ID and matching it against the number you entered. This usually takes a few minutes.

review.title: Pending manual review
review.body: A member of our team will review your documents personally, usually within one business day. We'll notify you on WhatsApp as soon as there's an update.

actionRequired.title: Please resubmit your documents
actionRequired.body: Our reviewer couldn't verify your identity from the photos you sent.
actionRequired.reason: The back of your ID is blurry. Please retake it in good light, holding the camera steady.

approved.title: Identity verified
approved.body: Thank you — your identity has been confirmed. The next step is a short video interview.

identityStatus.notify: You can close the app — we'll message you on WhatsApp when the status changes.

interview.title: Video interview
interview.subtitle: Record a short video introducing yourself. It helps our recruiters get to know you beyond your application.

prompts.name: Your name and where you live
prompts.why: Why you want to work in real estate
prompts.areas: The areas and compounds you know well

interview.referenceBody: A short sample interview from one of our agents.

tips.light: Sit facing a window or a good light source
tips.quiet: Choose a quiet place without background noise
tips.camera: Look at the camera and speak naturally

interview.permissionBody: We'll ask for access to your camera and microphone to record your interview. The video is used only for your application.

recorder.ready: Position your face inside the frame

preview.title: Review your recording
preview.body: Watch your video before submitting. You can record again if you're not happy with it.
preview.tooShort: Your recording is quite short. Aim for around one minute.

uploading.title: Uploading your interview
uploading.body: Please keep the app open until the upload is complete.

denied.title: Camera access is turned off
denied.body: To record your interview, Maskan needs access to your camera and microphone.
denied.step3: Allow Camera and Microphone, then come back here

submitted.title: Interview submitted
submitted.body: Thank you for recording your interview. Our recruitment team will review it carefully.

next.review: A recruiter watches your interview and reviews your application.
next.decision: You'll receive a decision, usually within 2–3 business days.
next.training: If accepted, you'll get immediate access to the Maskan training program.

submitted.notify: We'll notify you on WhatsApp and in the app as soon as a decision is made.

accepted.title: You passed the first step
accepted.body: Our recruitment team has approved your application. You're now invited to the Maskan training program.

next.courses: Watch short training courses at your own pace
next.quiz: Pass the final quiz to qualify
next.agent: Start working as a qualified Maskan agent

rejected.title: Thank you for applying
rejected.body: We appreciate the time you invested in your application. After careful review, you are not eligible to continue at this time.
rejected.note: This decision reflects our current requirements and is not a judgment of your abilities. We wish you every success.
rejected.contact: If you have questions, contact us at careers@maskan.example.
